title: Organization key-set draft, org-key-set-draft/1 (DEC-0131)
description: What an organization server serves at GET {issuer}/fabric/membership/v1/{org}/key-set/draft (DEC-0131 OX-1): the next org-key-set/1 it drafted, unsigned, for the root the owner's Fabric holds to sign. Public material only, served without a credential; its authenticity is the root's signature over it. docs/specification/membership.md.

org.description: The organization the draft is for; the draft names the same (FAC-SEM-151).

base.description: The last signed document the draft was made from, by revision and digest, or null for the first. The draft's revision is one above it (FAC-SEM-151).

draft.description: An org-key-set/1 without sig: every member the root signs, exactly (orgKeySetSigningInput has bytes for it).

digest.description: The draft's digest: SHA-256 of what its signer signs over it (FAC-SEM-151). The server accepts a signed document only when its signed bytes have this digest.
